metadata.title: Resolución 2011020764 de 2011 (INVIMA): reglamento sobre reportes de eventos adversos en investigación clínica con medicamentos en humanos
metadata.edition: Dated 10 June 2011 · Diario Oficial No. 48.109 of 23 June 2011 · in force on publication (Art. 7) · Arts. 3-7 (Spanish)
metadata.legal_basis: INVIMA resolution on adverse event reports in clinical research; the official Spanish text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
